explanation: Equal-mass elastic collision correctly transfers 30 m/s from body 0 to body 1 around step 6, then body 1 travels to the right arena boundary at ~30 m/s (~1 m per dt=0.0333 step) and passes through instead of bouncing, ending 0.88 beyond the wall at step 13. Likely cause: discrete boundary collision misses fast bodies even with 34 substeps, i.e. failed continuous collision / tunneling through the arena wall.
vision_note: The large red body moves steadily rightward toward the arena edge across steps 10 to 12 while the small blue body remains stationary. At step 13 the red body is halfway outside the right boundary instead of bouncing back inside.
